title: Add Auth And Sharable Links To Server And Sketchpad
description:
Add authentication to semio server and sketchpad (optional for remote kits). Add sharable links for kit, design and type with read-only options. 

Server changes:
- Add auth token system (session-scoped bearer tokens)
- Add session access modes: owner (read-write) and viewer (read-only)
- Auth middleware: token required for mutation endpoints, optional for read endpoints
- Sharable link generation: create read-only share tokens for kit/design/type views
- New endpoints: POST /sessions/{id}/share (create share link), GET /share/{token} (resolve share)

Sketchpad changes:
- SessionKitStore: send auth token with requests, handle 401/403
- Share dialog: generate and copy sharable links
- Read-only mode when accessing via share link
- URL support for share tokens
